draw.vertex: attribute vec4 ink; attribute vec2 edge; varying vec4 vInk; varying vec2 vEdge; void main(){vInk=ink;vEdge=edge; gl_Position=projectionMatrix*modelViewMatrix*vec4(position,1.0);}
draw.fragment: varying vec4 vInk; varying vec2 vEdge; void main(){float aa=max(fwidth(vEdge.x),0.000001);float alpha=vInk.a*(1.0-smoothstep(vEdge.y-aa*.5,vEdge.y+aa*.5,abs(vEdge.x)));gl_FragColor=vec4(vInk.rgb*alpha,alpha);}

parameters.label: 形状（0 方块 / 1 棱锥）
